text:
ema: FYI, NorthWind is hitting sustained p99 on /v1/embeddings for their Dedicated pool. Customer CS just escalated — they have a QPS spike and are seeing 3x tail latency vs yesterday. SLA risk if this continues.

devin: on it. Which pool and model variant? any error spikes (OOM / 503)?

luke-cs: pool: nw-dedicated-prod-2, model: rw-open-embed-v2-q4_8. Errors are 2-3% 503s during spikes. No OOMs reported in the initial logs.

rachel: stack traces show KV cache thrashing during long prefixes; p99 increases with sequence length >1024. Looks like batching + cache eviction contention.

sam: can we temporarily route NorthWind to hosted fallback (rw-open-embed-v2-ephemeral) to avoid SLA breaches? We should scope impact on cost.

mira: we can route, but that requires a routing policy change + canary. I can push an override for that customer. Quick note: hosted variant has slightly different quant profile; perf is stable for short seqs.

ema: ok propose plan: 1) mirror traffic to hosted fallback (read-only) 2) enable routing override for 100% if mirror stable 3) apply a hotpatch to dedicated runtime to reduce prefix caching churn 4) follow-up perf regression test and customer postmortem.

devin: owners: eng-runtime (hotpatch), eng-sre (routing change + canary), eng-platform (billing/quotas check), cs (customer comms). I can own the runtime fix if rachel and sam can pair for testing.

rachel: I can pair with devin. Quick review: small change to KV expiry heuristic and batching window. PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/pulls/1428 (WIP).

sam: tagging ops: @deploy-bot can you start a canary deployment for nw-dedicated-prod-2 with the debug image (runtime:fixture-20260317-debug)?

deploy-bot: canary started for nw-dedicated-prod-2 -> 3 nodes; health checks passing. Canary id: canary-20260317-09.

mira: routing override snippet (will update once we confirm):
```json
{
  "matcher": "customer.id == \"northwind\"",
  "route": "hosted:rw-open-embed-v2-ephemeral",
  "weight": 0.0
}
```
(We set weight to 0 for mirror first)

luke-cs: customer wants immediate mitigation; can we mirror now and escalate to 100% within 30m if no regression? Also need a short note to share with execs.

ema: yes mirror now. @mira please enable mirror. @devin/rachel ETA for hotpatch to land in canary?

rachel: hotpatch PR ready for review. If no blockers I can merge in 20–30m, then canary rollout ~15m.

devin: testing the patch locally against a replay of recent traffic now. Early signals look good (p99 down ~25% in replay).

mira: mirror enabled (weight 0) and logs forwarded to telemetry - id mirror-20260317-01. Observability: https://telemetry/internal/dashboards/northwind-embeds

deploy-bot: telemetry alert: mirror traffic healthy for 5m; error rate 0.1%, p99 on hosted ~210ms.

luke-cs: sharing this with NorthWind CSM now, telling them we have mirror live and will escalate to full routing if stable.

ema: actionable owners and timeline:
- eng-runtime (devin + rachel): land hotpatch -> merge in 30m, canary in 45m (owner)
- eng-sre (mira): mirror now (done), promote to 100% by +30m if stable (owner)
- eng-platform (sam): confirm billing/quotas on hosted fallback and ensure alerts for quota exhaustion (owner)
- cs (luke-cs): customer comms and SLA status updates (owner)

sam: looking into quota, will post update in 10m. If hosted quota is insufficient, fallback plan is rate-limit at proxy and ask customer to stagger retries.

rachel: tagging PR reviewers @ema @sam for quick review. Small change, tests added. PR: #1428.

devin: quick code review ping: the warmup path needs a minor tweak to not reset KV pointers during small batches — see inline comment.

ema: reviewing now. Also prep a short email for Legal/Support summarizing impact and mitigation for SLA reporting.

mira: canary shows 0.5% 503s on dedicated with debug image; after hotpatch test in canary, we'll compare.

deploy-bot: canary update: runtime PR merged -> rolling canary (canary-20260317-09) now at 50% nodes; health checks stable.

luke-cs: customer notified: "we have a mitigation live (mirroring to hosted) and an engineering hotfix rolling in canary. We'll update every 30 minutes."

sam: hosted quota OK for now, added alert if usage > 70% of quota.

ema: follow-ups: postmortem owners devin+rachel, timeline doc by cs (luke-cs), billing impact estimate by sam. Next check-in in 30m. :thumbsup:

mira: will promote to 100% routing at +30m if canary stable and cs approves.

devin: quick note — if promote fails, we fallback to rate-limit + retry-backoff. Keep channels open.

ema: thanks all. Closing interim loop here; ping this thread with any blockers.

(THREAD ENDS)
